name: 荷兰欧盟蓝卡居留许可
summary: 面向在荷兰从事高技能工作的非欧盟、欧洲经济区及瑞士人士，认可担保人并非必需。
summaryEn: For non-EU, EEA and Swiss nationals taking highly qualified work in the Netherlands; a recognised sponsor is not mandatory.

jobOffer.summary: 须有符合规定期限的荷兰高技能工作合同。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A Dutch contract for highly qualified employment meeting the applicable duration rule is required.

qualification.summary: 通常须有至少三年高等教育学历，或符合规定的同等层级相关工作经验。
qualification.summaryEn: Normally requires at least a three-year higher-education qualification or qualifying relevant experience at a comparable level.

salary.summary: 须达到申请时适用的欧盟蓝卡收入标准。
salary.summaryEn: The European Blue Card income requirement applicable at the time of application must be met.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
